criteria.label: Direct public-data intake
criteria.description: Can the workflow start from public datasets without a separate local stats-prep environment?

criteria.label: Standalone report delivery
criteria.description: Can the workflow emit a shareable offline report artifact rather than only an interactive session?

criteria.label: Structured provenance capture
criteria.description: Does the workflow preserve explicit dataset/contrast/run metadata in the output artifacts?

criteria.label: Batch multi-cohort reruns
criteria.description: Can the workflow be rerun across multiple cohorts under one contract rather than ad hoc one-off runs?

criteria.label: Offline shareability
criteria.description: Can the main analysis artifact be reviewed offline without a hosted server dependency?

criteria.label: Publication-ready exports
criteria.description: Does the workflow emphasize figure/report artifacts that can be reused in a manuscript context?

tools.source: Local repository workflow and generated benchmark outputs
tools.notes: Public GEO intake, provenance-tagged standalone HTML reports, and manifest-driven reruns are first-class features.
Strong local RNA-seq interpretation environment once DESeq2-style objects already exist, but not centered on public-data intake or manifest-level standalone report delivery.
Public-data reuse is strong, but the workflow centers on a hosted re-analysis environment rather than a provenance-tagged standalone report contract.
Scriptable package-level pathway analysis with figure outputs, but not a public-data intake or standalone delivery workflow.
Interactive enrichment exploration is the focus, not provenance-tagged standalone delivery or multi-cohort rerun contracts.
